about_the_game:
"One morning, you wake up to find your father gone. No trace. Only a letter remains. I had to leave. It's for the best... But something doesn’t add up. He never spoke of leaving. He was always there. Always said family comes first."

Step into the shoes of a young man who, in the wake of his father's sudden disappearance, sets out on a journey to uncover the truth. This adventure will take you through mysterious, uncharted worlds – breathtaking yet dangerous – filled with puzzles, traps, and enemies.

"A Journey" is a 2.5D atmospheric platformer with realistic 3D visuals, combining exploration, logical challenges, and dynamic combat, all woven into a touching story about loss, determination, and hope. 

Key Features:

🧩A story full of mystery

Gradually uncover what really happened, who your father was… and who you truly are.

🌍Multi-world adventure

The forest is just the beginning. Explore diverse environments, each with unique atmospheres, mechanics, and surprises.

🎮2.5D platforming with realistic 3D graphics

Experience the depth and immersion of 3D visuals from a side-scrolling perspective.

⚔️ AI combat system

Engage in battles that require both reflexes and strategy. Every enemy is a potential challenge.

✨ Unlock supernatural abilities

As you progress, discover powers that let you overcome obstacles—and open new paths.

🎵 Immersive soundtrack and sound design

Music and ambient sound that amplify the emotions of adventure, mystery, and discovery.

name: A Journey Into the Unknown
short_description: Awaken in a world forever changed. Your father is gone, and in his place—only a cryptic note. Uncover the truth behind his disappearance and the mystery within yourself. A 2.5D journey of puzzles, combat, and forgotten power buried deep inside.
